kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتكافأ (form VI)
# نَتَكَافَأُ (natakāfaʔu) /na.ta.kaː.fa.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# نَتَكَافَأَ (natakāfaʔa) /na.ta.kaː.fa.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
# نَتَكَافَأْ (natakāfaʔ) /na.ta.kaː.faʔ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَكَافَأَ (takāfaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
